profile.reading:
This record covers an Oracle owned or leased site at 3380 Northeast 79th Avenue in the Tanasbourne Commerce Center, a suburban business park in Hillsboro, Washington County, Oregon. Hillsboro sits at the center of Oregon's Silicon Forest, a technology corridor built up around semiconductor manufacturing, most visibly Intel's large fabrication campuses in the same city, along with a wider cluster of hardware and software companies that grew up around that base.

Oracle's presence in the Portland area traces in large part to its 2010 acquisition of Sun Microsystems, which had long operated significant engineering and hardware operations in the Pacific Northwest, including sites associated with SPARC processor and Solaris operating system development. Oracle retained much of that regional footprint after the acquisition, folding former Sun facilities and staff into its hardware and cloud infrastructure divisions, though Oracle's own site does not publish a facility level description of this specific Tanasbourne Commerce Center address, its function, or how it relates to that Sun Microsystems legacy.

Nothing in the public record identifies this address as a customer facing colocation or wholesale data center of the kind found elsewhere in this registry. Business park addresses of this kind, in Tanasbourne and similar Hillsboro and Beaverton office parks, more commonly house corporate offices, engineering labs, and internal server rooms supporting research and development or regional operations rather than commercial data center space marketed to outside tenants, and that is the more likely role for this building absent evidence to the contrary.

Washington County property and permit records place the parcel within the established Tanasbourne Commerce Center business park, a multi building office and light industrial development, but no permit filing, zoning case or trade press coverage specific to this address describing generator capacity, cooling infrastructure or a purpose built data hall was found. No expansion announcement, outage report or construction filing tied specifically to this building has been identified.

As with many large technology companies, Oracle treats the technical details of internal facilities as operationally sensitive rather than public information, publishing specifications only for offerings it actively markets, such as its public cloud regions, none of which are located at this Hillsboro address. Readers looking for verified power, capacity or tenancy figures for this specific site will not find them published by the company.
